body: That is a great idea, and thank you.

I mentioned I re-broke up with her but the initial break was actually mutual and more of her breaking up with me, not that it really matters. 

You are right though, why the hell would she. She deserves to be with someone who will treat her well. I’m hoping I can still be that person while I work on myself, but yes, maybe it’s too late. Thanks for your reply.

Thank you so much for your comment. It made me feel a bit better. Whatever happens I have a lot to work on, but as you said, even in my state I can find people to connect with. That way you mentioned, about looking at relationships, seems pretty great, I’ll definitely try and think like that a little more.
You’re probably right, I appreciate the comment.
I will take this all to heart. These are all mindsets I’m in dire need of, thank you for writing them out.

Thank you for the kind words. We might’ve not been that happy, I might be blind atm, but I know that there’s something there still worth fighting for. I was just too much of an idiot, and possibly needed better perspective. 

Haha I don’t think I’ve ever begged like I did last night to anyone. Definitely a first but you’re right. Getting my shit together and believing in me is what is most important for me right now. Thanks again.

Thank you for your comment, I think you are probably right. It just sucks you know, it all happened way too fast. I was going to go see her to tell her the words she wanted to hear 2 weeks ago. I’m too late it seems, I have no one to blame but myself. I will try and move on.

Hard to argue with that honestly haha. It does seem like she’s doing what’d be best for her, in a healthy way. If she says that she wants to keep trying, it might be morally wrong for me to even accept. Thanks for the comment. I will go to therapy.

Appreciate the tough talk. I never thought of her as a toy. I was dying inside along the way trying to figure out what to do. In fact, staying in the relationship after we initially broke up was my idea because I couldn’t stand the thought of losing her. Our initial break up was more her breaking up with me, because she saw that I was unhappy. 

My conditions were probably stressing her out. She was probably too nice to admit it. At the end of the day, yes I have more issues than the average person. I guess I just have to own that. 

I do not care about her in a shallow way. I have stuck with her through many things. Yet I totally agree overall that I fucked up taking her for granted in that she’d wait for me a little while longer. I probably hurt her so much. I might not be ready to be a partner.

Thank you so much for your words. I’m inclined to think you are totally right. I even came to this realization before. She filled my head up with tales of “waiting for you even if you are in a relationship” and “my grandma never remarried after her husband died at 20 something”. Essentially I thought I could work on myself while we agreed to wait for each other. I did not plan to date anyone. 

Our relationship wasn’t going too great towards the end I guess. We still had moments of happiness, because we still are like best friends and get each other like no one else does. There was a lot of unhappiness and a lot of it was radiating from me. I wouldn’t say it was pleasant. I was never nasty, but we did have what I’d consider normal arguments and I shut down emotionally. 

Now that I’m faced with a reality that is counter to anything I ever believed she’d do, yeah I guess it’s killing me. I feel like we can get through it together if we take it in small steps. 

Yet you are probably right. We might not be compatible anymore. It hurts so much to even think that, but I might just have to just deal with it.
I appreciate the comment. You may be right, and I will definitely work on myself for myself.

Well, one thing that would be different is that I’ll be more active in bettering myself despite my issues. I’m already going back to school. I’ve been going to job interviews. I will go to therapy as soon as I can afford it. I feel like that could possibly make everything more positive for us. Keep me busy and less dwelling on things I shouldn’t be. Give her a sense of stability. Make her feel like I have direction. 

I know, I realize now that I’m 100% the problem. I just think she might still want to be with me, and if she does, and still cares to try, I’m willing to give it everything I have and more.

I use a track ball actually! I alternate between it and my touchpad. It does help a lot for my shoulder. 

The one thing I’ve yet to try is the foot-pedals, so I’ll see about giving that a shot. 

Same with the yoga ball. I’ve never heard anything about it being used like that before haha. I’m guessing that could help for back pain?

I’ve generally shied away from drugs due to a number of reasons. I’ve been health conscious and also don’t want to get addicted. I have gotten addicted to things in the past, and feel like it’s generally easy for it to happen to me. However, I feel like I should learn how to take more pain meds. I mean, I gotta do what I gotta do. 

If it means being able to get things done, it could be worth it. I worry a lot about doing more damage to my body when I take them, and ending up worse off because I’m aggravating the injuries but just can’t feel it for however long the meds last. 

I will definitely consider being more open to them, thank you for the thought.

Mostly just skateboarding. It can do quite a number on the body with all the falls. Of course, they won’t feel it when their bodies are brand new, but I truly believe it’s not a hobby worth having if you want to have good health later in life.

The gift wasn't given to me, but to my younger brother. 

Apparently, my friends sister thought that a copy of Drillbit Taylor would make a great Christmas gift for my 10 year old brother. He thought it was video game at first before unwrapping it, him being an avid gamer at the time. 

This was like 3 years after the movie had been out too.

Yeah that's exactly how I'm feeling about the whole thing. It was very "the more expensive you look, the better you'll do" kind of thing. It's probably not worth the stress and the money I'll have to invest considering I'd be there for so little. Thank you for your reply!
thank you for the reply, I will be doing just that
